evidence: Anonymous customer-selected bytes -> Bytes uploaded and later signed to selected staff without signature/scanning
MZ bytes labeled application/pdf pass local checks; repository has no scanner or magic-byte validation.
method: static dataflow plus bounded local diagnostic where stated

impact: Disguised malicious content can be delivered to pharmacy staff
sink: Bytes uploaded and later signed to selected staff without signature/scanning

evidence: Browser-declared MIME is accepted even when bytes do not match the claimed prescription type.

attack_path_facts: A mislabeled file can be uploaded, but the repository evidence does not establish stored active execution, cross-user disclosure, or another concrete security consequence.
